name: Oc hut
summary: Ốc hút are small apple snails cooked with lemongrass, chili, garlic, and coconut water, a spicy plate you eat with a pick or by sucking the meat from the shell. People eat them in the late afternoon and after rain.
howToEat: The culture office lists các loại ốc hút among the snacks at the Don An Phú festival.
ZaloPay: small apple snails cooked with lemongrass, chili, garlic, and coconut water, eaten with a pick or by sucking, in the late afternoon and after rain.
where: The festival ground south of cầu Cổ Lũy, thôn Phú Thọ, when Lễ hội Don An Phú is on.
seoDescription: Ốc hút in Quảng Ngãi: small apple snails with lemongrass, chili, garlic, and coconut water, sucked from the shell in the late afternoon.
